rationale: Nitrogen-limited growth in final 4h. Acetate and propionate are primary C sources; amino acids (lysine, alanine, proline) provide supplemental C and N. Fermentation yields CO₂, formate, and butyrate as overflow products. Growth rate 0.08/h is sustainable with available NH₄ (6 mM) and amino acid N pools (~8 mM), supporting ~1.3 gDW synthesis. Mass balance verified.
